prompt: The temperature was $-8\degree$F. It dropped another $5$ degrees. What is the new temperature?
hint: A drop in temperature makes the number smaller. The temperature is already below zero, so it moves even farther from zero.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Picture a thermometer as a vertical number line. Start at $-8$ and move down $5$ more marks.
A drop in temperature makes the number smaller. The temperature is already below zero, so it moves even farther from zero.
Subtract the drop from the starting temperature: $-8 - 5$. On a number line this is $5$ steps left from $-8$.

explanation: A drop of $5$ degrees means subtracting $5$ from the starting temperature: $-8 - 5$.
On a number line, start at $-8$ and move $5$ units to the left, away from $0$.
This lands $8 + 5 = 13$ units below zero, so $-8 - 5 = -13$.
The new temperature is $-13\degree$F, colder than before.
